text: IRGC Warns Of Retaliation For Any Attack, Forces Ready To Strike Any Invader | War News | News18Amid rising tensions in the Middle East, Iran’s elite military force, the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), has issued a strong warning, declaring that its forces are fully prepared to retaliate against any attack.
